_about: Garathorm Vineyard: the vintner's house, his cellar rats, and the giant wine spider that has taken the storage room.

41800.name: vintner old
41800.long_desc: The old vintner sits on the edge of his bed, worrying about his cellar.
41800.description: Purple-stained hands and a red nose, and a look of real fear whenever his eyes go to the cellar stair. Something has taken his best vintages, and he dares not go down.

41801.name: rat cellar
41801.long_desc: A fat cellar rat gnaws at the bung of a cask.
41801.description: Sleek and bold from a diet of spilled wine and grape skins.

41802.name: spider wine giant
41802.long_desc: A giant wine spider hangs in its web among the bottle racks, its belly the colour of claret.
41802.description: A bloated spider as big as a cart, its swollen abdomen stained a deep wine-red. Wrapped bottles and wrapped rats hang in its web like fruit.
